Package com.egradx.notification.channel

Class EgradxProviderBackedChannel<P>

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.notification.channel.EgradxProviderBackedChannel<P>
Type Parameters:
P - the provider type
All Implemented Interfaces:
EgradxNotificationChannel
Direct Known Subclasses:
EgradxSmsChannel, EgradxWhatsAppChannel
public abstract class EgradxProviderBackedChannel<P> extends Object implements EgradxNotificationChannel
A channel whose sending is done by one of several interchangeable providers — SMS gateways, WhatsApp APIs — chosen per organization by the provider setting of its stored configuration. Enabling the channel for an organization, or moving it to another gateway, is a settings change; adding a gateway is one provider bean.

Handles what every such channel needs: finding the organization's configuration (its own, then the all-organizations one), the provider it names, and a precise reason whenever it cannot send. Numbers are E.164; content is text only.
